steps.code:
# Now update the note content by replacing TODO with the release months.
content = note['content']
lines = content.splitlines()
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists from line like "- Title BY Artists RELEASED_AT TODO"
        prefix = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
        if prefix.startswith('- '):
            prefix = prefix[2:]
        title_artists = prefix.split(' BY ')
        title = title_artists[0].strip()
        info = song_info.get(title)
        if info:
            new_line = f"- {title} BY {info['artists']} RELEASED_AT {info['month']}"
            new_lines.append(new_line)
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)
new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
